THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
12 · Slave pens · area 5
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Iron bars divide the chamber into cells. Two armed Redbrands stand guard. A woman and a young woman are confined to one side; a boy is held apart from them.

The bars turn the room into a place of confinement rather than ordinary storage. The doors and the space beside them matter if anyone is to leave in a hurry. You can address whoever is actually present, inspect the locks, or check the surrounding route before promising a way out.

Ask the players

How do you protect the captives? Do you fight, negotiate, or create a distraction?
